541 Team was able to strain the organic growth of the artifact EL-QV57-1 and have determined that the artifact is some form of organic powersource that grows around the generator and is able to produce immense amounts of energy for very long periods of time.

542 Artifact EL-QV57-1 has suddenly started showing organic activity and seems to be rapidly growing. There are multiple theories that specific type of genetic mutation would be required to activate and operate Elder originated artifacts and the team has been working on confirming the theory and isolating the gene type.
